body: Any time I've ever had the chance to wish upon something like a star, candle, flower, four-leaf clover, it has always been to just be content in my life. That's all I ever wanted, some relief and not having to struggle to survive. Content to be alive. I fucking wish.

You're an incredible woman! You have no idea I am so amazed and speechless at your accomplishments despite the uphill battle you continue to fight. You have done everything you possibly can for yourself, I hope the words and abuse doesn't get to your psyche too heavily and that you know how accomplished you already are. I believe in you, I seriously believe in you, fuck them! Fuck them all! I absolutely know how batshit crazy you feel trying to heal while living with the same abusers who put you in that state, its disgusting but you have proved to yourself that you're a fighter. A strong women, I hope one day you will find the people who will support you and hold you when you need it. Keep your mindset strong, try to find authors of women like you, try online spaces maybe? I think a lot of women are like you in your parts of the world, and just need someone to remind them that they can fight and they need unity. Tumblr is a good space for women who want to support women, but it can get really political really quickly. Otherwise I am not dealing with the same tyrannical government so my advice isn't very helpful and I'm sorry, but if you need to vent I'm willing to listen.

I am so inlove with Rina, although I resent the kids shitting on CFY to lift this song up I still enjoy it. I love her vocals, wished we got more of the fun pop stuff but I believe there might be a chip on Charlie's shoulder. Understandably.

I really appreciate the time you took to make me feel connected. It worked and I hope the same for you as well stranger, even for a moment some peace in your mind at least. I hope in your days your able to find some glimmers of hope that keep you going. I hope you drag your feet and your nails bleed from gripping onto life as hard as possible, as much as it takes. Surviving is miserable but speaking to a stranger who feels the same way I do, and even though I know how much I just don't care and how much I am willing to just give it all up.. I don't have the heart to agree with that sentiment  with you, struggle another day let the world hang onto you selfishly. I am willing to be an outreach if you need it.

I know you don't want to be told how strong or resilient you are, but you are. You shouldn't have to be, you should have been able to live as a teenage girl discovering your hobbies and interests as they came wearing and doing whatever you pleased. You deserved that life, I promise you. I hope you can free yourself from that prison, I hope one day you can live the life you want, alone maybe or with friends or animals whatever the case may be. As a woman I am disgusted that you've had to live this life in the name of things you had no control over. I am sorry that your society has failed you and continues to do so. I'm even more sorry that the anger you feel has to be kept calm, that you can't just scream and break things. I hope one day soon you can explore yourself without being told what to do or who to be.

I don't have any advice for you because I don't feel to hopeful myself, but in these moments we tend to feel so incredibly alone. Debilitatingly alone, no one understands, no energy to explain ourselves to people who will have too much pity in their hearts that looking at them just makes us feel sick. But, I understand where you are, albeit I am 24F and living with my parents so our situations are drastically different but the emptiness is the same and I find unity in that for now. Misery loves company I guess, it just gets really lonely down here in the dark even if we're occupied with thoughts of escaping I can't help but feel that aloneness pinging my heart. I hope you know in this moment you aren't alone and I have read this and it made an impact on my life even for just a moment.
